notes: Page states parent Nortek, formerly Nordyne Manufacturing. Page lists sister/similar brands but establishes no shared-system reuse, so usesStylesOf is null and all styles below are encoded from this page's own text. Counting convention: character positions on the normalized serial govern throughout this page. Digit-only counting is falsified on this page: it gives month 82 (invalid) for style-1 and an unresolvable year 50 for the held duplicate-labelled style, while character counting decodes every page example validly. The page's second section labelled Style 4 (E2E-9705 01234) is HELD, not shipped: its normalized shape (letter-digit-letter + 9 digits) is identical to shipped style-3 but its year/month positions differ ([4,6]/[6,8] vs [3,5]/[5,7]), so the two cannot coexist under first-match semantics. Style-3 and the first Style 4 share normalized shape AND positions, so they are merged into one shipped style with both page examples.

styles.notes: Page example serial; expected values decoded from the page-stated character positions.

Page states a year position only, no month; shipped year-only. Character counting per the page-wide convention (digit-only counting would give 1991, inconsistent with the positions that the page's other examples force).

styles.era: 12-character normalized serials, letter-digit-letter followed by 9 digits
styles.notes: Merges the page's Style 3 (G6R9905-05028) and first Style 4 (M 1 G 9807-05432): identical normalized shape and identical year/month positions, so a single style decodes both page examples.
